sections.Profile:
The "Shamrock" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on October 22, 1956, is a two-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1956
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Folk Tale, Myth, Original Theme, Fantasy
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Harry Williams
- Art: George Molentin
